correctness.rationale: The exact domain has 10 reverse-complement orbits and 1023 nonempty subsets. Each optimal superstring is represented by an ordering and orientation of the length-two reads, because all selected orbits are distinct and same-length occurrences have distinct starts. Held–Karp recurrence computes the minimum. The greedy state recurrence lists every unordered component pair, orientations, ordering and globally maximum proper overlap; its max recursion counts every adversarial tie and strictly reduces the component count. The actual standalone verify.py completed all 1023 inputs and 638579 canonical memo states with integer comparisons. It cross-checked all n<=4 optima by explicit permutation enumeration and all n<=3 greedy maxima by an independent uncached recursion. The certified table has 282 cases with difference exactly one, all others zero, and global ratio 5/4. The explicit AA/AC/CA witness proves sharpness. No infinite-family extrapolation is made.

originality.rationale: The 2026 Yamano–Shibuya works analyze general approximation and cycle-cover methods, and the earlier Fici et al. work proves a general compression guarantee for a reversal-based direct greedy rule. No inspected result implies the 1023-case exact all-ties profile or additive-one gap for DNA dimers. Orenstein–Shamir addresses optimum coverage of all k-mer reverse-complement classes, not greedy behavior for arbitrary subsets. Published research-record searches produced no covering result; absence from an index is not treated as proof of uniqueness. The nearest accessible historical fixed-length greedy calculations involve ordinary binary length-three/four inputs without Watson–Crick reversal, which are neither equivalent nor stronger.

value.rationale: Strand-aware two-letter DNA reads are the smallest four-letter alphabet setting with 10 nontrivial reverse-complement classes, a motivated exact baseline for overlap assembly. The statement completely classifies the direct greedy algorithm on every admissible input (1023), provides an exact additive-one guarantee, a sharp global 5/4 length ratio, worst-case ratios at every possible input size, and the complete 282-instance nonoptimal distribution. This is a natural complete finite-domain algorithmic classification rather than a selected parameter slice without motivation. No relevance to longer reads or cycle-cover variants is asserted.
